# Annus Zulfiqar

I'm a PhD candidate in the Computer Science and Engineering department at the University of Michigan, Ann Arbor, advised by professor [Muhammad Shahbaz](https://gitlab.com/mshahbaz/mshahbaz.gitlab.io/-/wikis/home). My research is about rethinking data plane architectures and algorithms to build scalable networked systems that overcome traditional resource limitations and adapt quickly to dynamic network conditions. Around this central theme, my research has spanned Cloud Networking (SIGCOMM CCR'23, ASPLOS'25), ML for Systems (NSDI'26, ASPLOS'23), and Systems for ML (IEEE CAL'25, Arxiv'25).
